stats.evidence: Setter @0x314 v_u_1=15/18/20/25; resolver @0x3c3 pulls it via GetUpgradeModifiedValue(...,9,...) (strength-type mod) and it is the FIRST displayed ValueUnit. Eligibility proto @0x76a gates on target.ALCHEMIST_FillDamageData >= 15 (the rank-1 value), i.e. an element/fill count that must be reached.

stats.label: base_damage
stats.evidence: Setter @0x314 v_u_2=1000/1500/1750/2000 (classic damage magnitude/shape). Resolver @0x3c3 wraps it as Engine.UpgradedValue(v_u_2) and applies mod-type 10; the per-frame loop @0x882 does damageData:SetBaseAmount(upgradedValue) before v54:DamageDD(damageData).

Lotus_Powersuits_Alchemist_Abilities_Alc.rank_param_meaning: p6 = ability rank (1,2,3, else=max 4). Setter @0x3ee also has an early IsFightingGame() preset branch (Duviri/arena) that overrides all ranks. The 0.15/0.20/0.25/0.30 + 1/2/3/4 tuple comes from the augment-tier setter @0x6e5 where the param is the AUGMENT level, not the base rank.

stats.label: radius
stats.evidence: Setter @0x3ee v_u_4=10 for all ranks (FightingGame preset=5). @0xc7b displays it under UNIT_METER, and the cast loop @0x1211 uses it as the AoE reach: gRegion:FindAll(gBaseAvatarType, position, 0, v_u_4) and the line-deco spawn Vector(0,0,v_u_4).

stats.label: base_damage
stats.evidence: Setter @0x3ee v_u_2=500/650/800/1000 (FightingGame=20). Resolver @0x534 wraps as UpgradedValue (mod 10) -> returned as v_u_12 and fed to damageData:SetBaseAmount(v_u_12) in @0x1211 before avatarOwner:DamageDD(damageData).

stats.label: heal_amount
stats.evidence: Setter @0x3ee v_u_5=0.075/0.1/0.12/0.15 (small flats). Resolver returns it (third value v_u_7); @0x1211 pushes v37 * v_u_7 (enemies-hit x per-enemy) into ALCHEMIST_EvaluateHold, and the heal proto @0x22f1 does avatarOwner:Heal(..., GetMaxHealth() * p3) — p3 being this per-enemy fraction.

stats.label: misc_multiplier
stats.evidence: Augment-tier setter @0x6e5 v_u_3=1/2/3/4 keyed off augment level (paired with 0.15..0.30). Used in @0x1211 as v_u_9 in cooldownTime - v_u_9 (a cooldown-reduction bucket), so it is an augment level/amount, not a base combat stat.

stats.label: misc_multiplier
stats.evidence: Augment magnitude from @0x6e5/@0xef6 v_u_2=0.15/0.20/0.25/0.30; displayed as math.floor(v_u_2*100) (i.e. 15/20/25/30%). Distinct proto/signature from the 500.. damage table (per-proto upvalue names collide). This is the augment percentage stat.

Lotus_Powersuits_Alchemist_Abilities_Alc.rank_param_meaning: p6 = ability rank (1,2,3, else=max 4) in setter @0x3bd (mirrored in @0xa25, @0x16d8 bytecode). The 6/9/12/15 single-value table comes from the augment/hold setters @0x643/@0xd1b/@0x79f where the param is the AUGMENT level and a second flag (p3~=1) guards it.

stats.label: radius
stats.evidence: Setter @0x3bd v_u_1=8/8/8/15 (flat then jumps at max — typical radius). Resolver @0x4ed seeds v6=v_u_1 and returns it as the first stat; small meter-scale magnitude consistent with AoE size.

stats.label: duration
stats.evidence: Setter @0x3bd v_u_4=3 for all ranks. In @0x4ed it becomes v9 = (2 - GetUpgradedAbilityValue(1)) * v_u_4 — the standard ability-DURATION-mod scaling (2 - durationStat) — and @0xa25 assembles the _T.DURATION tooltip table. Constant 3s base duration.

stats.label: base_damage
stats.evidence: Setter @0x3bd v_u_2=100/150/200/250 (canonical base-damage shape). Resolver @0x4ed reads it via GetUpgradeModifiedValue(v_u_2,9,...) and it is wrapped/modified as the damage value in the DURATION/damage blob.

stats.label: targets_count
stats.evidence: Setter @0x3bd v_u_5=3/4/5/6 (small integer ramp). Displayed as a ValueUnit in @0xa25's DURATION table alongside damage and the 1.5 multiplier; kit-wise Transmute scatters transmutation orbs, so this is the per-cast orb/projectile count.

stats.label: damage_multiplier
stats.evidence: Setter @0x3bd v_u_3=1.5 for all ranks (classic 1.x multiplier). Carried into the @0xa25 tooltip table as a ValueUnit next to damage; constant, unscaled — a damage/effect multiplier.

stats.label: misc_multiplier
stats.evidence: Separate augment/hold table from @0x643/@0xd1b/@0x79f: v_u_1=6/9/12/15 keyed off augment level with the p3~=1 guard; @0xd1b cjson-encodes it as {CheckHold=v_u_1}. Distinct signature from the 8/8/8/15 radius table; an augment 'CheckHold' value (likely duration/count).

Lotus_Powersuits_Alchemist_Abilities_Alc.rank_param_meaning: p8 = ability rank (1,2,3, else=max 4) in setter @0x3f9. Resolver @0x570 returns the six modded values consumed by the cast loop @0xaba, which packs them into an ability-stats table {duration, endBurstNumProjectiles, endBurstRadius, elements, elementIdx}.

stats.label: duration
stats.evidence: Setter @0x3f9 v_u_1=30 for all ranks (paired with an identical v_u_3=30 that is deduped out). Resolver @0x570 returns it (mod type 9) as the first displayed ValueUnit; its twin v_u_3=30 is wrapped as UpgradedValue and lands in the 'duration' field. 30 is a canonical ability-duration magnitude.

stats.label: base_damage
stats.evidence: Setter @0x3f9 v_u_5=100/150/200/250 (definitive base-damage shape). Resolver @0x570 reads it via GetUpgradeModifiedValue(v_u_5,9,...) with math.floor and it is the headline scaled number; in @0xaba it drives v38 = v_u_5 / v_u_2 (the spray loop budget). Shape strongly implies damage though it also meters projectile output.

stats.label: radius
stats.evidence: Setter @0x3f9 v_u_7=10/12/14/16. In @0xaba the ability-stats table sets endBurstRadius = v_u_7 + v_u_11, i.e. this is the base end-burst AoE radius (used by the RadialDamage on cast end in @0x184b/@0x21ce).

stats.label: move_speed
stats.evidence: Setter @0x3f9 v_u_2=4/6/7/8. In @0xaba it scales the dash push velocity: v35 = v34 * v_u_2 -> motionControl:SetPushVelocity(v35), and is the divisor v38=v_u_5/v_u_2 for spray cadence. So it governs Vial Rush's travel speed.

stats.label: targets_count
stats.evidence: Setter @0x3f9 v_u_4=4/5/6/8. Resolver @0x570 returns it (v13, mod 9) and @0xaba stores it as tbl.endBurstNumProjectiles; @0x21ce uses endBurstNumProjectiles to drive the end-burst projectile loop count (v16 = endBurstNumProjectiles / 1).

stats.label: radius
stats.evidence: Setter @0x3f9 v_u_6=4/5/7/9. Resolver @0x570 returns it via GetUpgradeModifiedValue(v_u_6,3,...) as v_u_11, which is added to the end-burst radius in @0xaba (endBurstRadius = v_u_7 + v_u_11). Contributes to AoE size; could alternatively be an element/projectile count (inserted as v26 into elementIdx), hence low confidence.

Lotus_Powersuits_AntiMatter_Abilities_Mo.rank_param_meaning: p8 = ability rank (1,2,3, else=max 4) in setter @0x5d7. The setter branches first on v_u_1.IsPvpEnabled(): a PvP preset table (flatter, lower damage) vs the PvE table. So each stat has separate PvE and PvP rank ramps. The 1.25/1.5/1.75/2 table is the AUGMENT (@0xa69/@0xb1a/@0x1157), keyed off augment level.

stats.label: damage_multiplier
stats.evidence: Setter @0x5d7: PvE 2/3/4/6, PvP flat 2. Read at mod type 3; downstream @0x2888 combines it into the 'damage' field (v20 = v_u_3+1 when augment-primed, else 1 - v_u_3), i.e. Nova's damage-vulnerability multiplier applied to primed enemies. (Alt reading: wave-expansion time, so medium.)

stats.label: radius
stats.evidence: PvP-only slot in setter @0x5d7 (v_u_6=5/6/7/8), the PvP counterpart of the PvE 10/15/20/30 radius; meter-scale AoE. In @0x83a it is min-clamped and fed to GetTargetsInRange/AddDeltaAttenuation as the affect radius.

stats.label: slow_amount
stats.evidence: Setter @0x5d7 PvE 0.3/0.35/0.4/0.5, PvP flat 0.5. Feeds tbl.deltaAtten (@0x2888) -> avatar:AddDeltaAttenuation(...), Nova's negative delta-attenuation = slow/time-dilation. Resolver @0x83a clamps the delta-attenuation value to <=0.75 (Nova's signature 75% slow cap), so this is the base slow fraction.

stats.label: base_damage
stats.evidence: Setter @0x5d7 PvE 150/300/500/800, PvP 140/160/180/200. Wrapped as Engine.UpgradedValue(v_u_2) (mod 10) in @0x83a; the primed-enemy detonation @0x4233 does radialDamageData:SetBaseAmount(unk3) from this value. PvP values are much lower/flatter — the classic PvP damage scaling — confirming base_damage.

stats.label: duration
stats.evidence: Setter @0x5d7 PvE 6/7/8/10, PvP 1/2/3/4. Read via GetUpgradeModifiedValue(v_u_4,9,...). Displayed as 5 + v_u_4*5 (@0xdc4 / helper @0xa3a) = 35/40/45/55s in PvE — the prime/debuff duration enemies stay affected.

stats.label: radius
stats.evidence: PvE-only slot in setter @0x5d7 (v_u_5=10/15/20/30), the PvE counterpart to the PvP 5/6/7/8 radius. The cast loop @0x17eb grows the wave radius from 5 and does gRegion:FindAll(gLotusNpcAvatarType, position, 0, v14) over this area; 10-30m matches Molecular Prime's large AoE.

stats.label: damage_multiplier
stats.evidence: Augment table (@0xa69 SetAugmentValueByLevel, @0xb1a, @0x1157, @0x2cd0): v_u_1=1.25/1.5/1.75/2 keyed off augment level (guarded by p3~=1). Displayed as math.floor((v_u_1+1)*100) = 225/250/275/300%. This is the augment's added damage-vulnerability multiplier, distinct from the base 2/3/4/6 table.
